title: Chapter 1217
text:
The last time I took a leave of absence was two months ago. I feel that this leave period is still quite long.

PS: Speaking of which, I've been paying attention to the epidemic for the past two months. Occasionally, I'll sigh. A seemingly stable life can't withstand the storm. After seeing the Western scenery, it's already a blessing to be born in China.

Take a day off for "Godly Mechanic".
